episodes.synopsis: Hideto Tsuji is a young man who's given up on soccer after his old team turned against him. But soccer might not have given up on him, as his school's high school team just got a new coach that's a famous former pro player!
episodes.title: Useless

episodes.synopsis: Hideto is ready to give up on soccer forever when he meets an unexpected friend from his past, Kohei, who's now a top soccer player who played in England. His friend's overjoyed to see him, but can he live up to their expectations?
episodes.title: Group of Losers

episodes.synopsis: Coach Kamiya is ready to whip the losing Kakegawa team into shape, and he's not afraid to change things to do it. But when he takes one of the team's top players off the starting roster, he faces a revolt on the field.
episodes.title: The Ones Who Leave

episodes.synopsis: Coach Kamiya has set a tough deadline for the Kakegawa soccer team: they have 1 month to win a game or he's shutting them down. But their first match is a devastating loss, and the only have time to play one more game.
episodes.title: Shaking

episodes.synopsis: Kakegawa plays their first real game against a powerful school who came from out of town to beat them.
episodes.title: Old Friend

episodes.synopsis: A star player from Italy shows up to play with the Kakegawa soccer team.
episodes.title: Naporitan

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the traditional Kakegawa training camp, and Coach Kamiya is even more excited than the players.
episodes.title: Training Camp

episodes.synopsis: The Kakegawa team plays its first game at the qualifiers, and finds itself up against a terrifying puppet master!
episodes.title: Thread

episodes.synopsis: Tsuji's got closer to his teammates, but at the same time he's made a dangerous enemy.
episodes.title: Collapse

episodes.synopsis: Tsuji quits the team after an article in the newspaper reveals his tormented past.
episodes.title: Emptiness

episodes.synopsis: A surprising visit changes the way Tsuji plays soccer forever.
episodes.title: Left Leg

episodes.synopsis: The team challenges Kohei in the beginning of the final game before the nationals.
episodes.title: Aloof

episodes.synopsis: Kakegawa faces off against Nomada in the final seconds of the prefectural championships.
episodes.title: Beginning
